verdict.rationale: Docusaurus is a static site generator, so it has no production dataset in the usual sense. Its analogue of a sandbox is testing changes away from the live deployment: `docusaurus start` serves a local dev preview, `docusaurus serve` previews the production build locally before deploying, and docusaurus.new offers a throwaway in-browser playground. missing for 10: a documented staging or preview-deployment workflow framed as sandbox vs production isolation, any agent-oriented sandbox guidance, and independent corroboration that these preview modes work for safe testing.
